Vanessa / team — taking the tech lead on the matrix. A few notes from my initial pass:

- Entitlement model: recommend a hybrid entitlement where ACME purchases a seat entitlement per user (ENT-SEAT-ACME) and we expose a separate usage entitlement for API calls (ENT-API-ACME) capped by tier. This maps cleanly to marketplace metering and keeps reconciliation straightforward.
- Fulfillment webhooks: we'll implement a signed POST to AWS with HMAC header + attempt/retry semantics (0, 1, 3 retries) and idempotency token. AWS expects the endpoint to respond 200/202 for accepted events; otherwise they retry — we'll log 4xx/5xx for alerting.
- Billing reconciliation: we'll emit a daily usage export to an S3 bucket (CSV) and a monthly summarized file for settlements. We should confirm whether ACME wants consolidated AWS settlement or direct invoicing.

I attached a CSV export sample and filled the first-pass mapping for the ACME trial tier. Please review and flag any product SKUs I missed.

Attachment: entitlement-mapping.csv (CSV, 6KB)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
